title: Negotiate and sign the sale contract
summary: Choose a buyer, negotiate the contract and manage the buyer's due diligence.
outlineSteps: Compare offers on price, deposits, timing and financing certainty
Check each buyer's capital and record of closing
Pick a buyer and sign a letter of intent
Map the existing loan's payoff or assumption path into the timeline
Negotiate the sale contract with counsel
Agree the deed form and what the seller will represent
Get the approvals to sign under the governing agreement
Sign the contract and confirm the deposit is in escrow
Deliver diligence materials on the contract's schedule
Request the tenant estoppels the contract requires
Respond to title, survey and diligence objections
Handle any repricing request before the deposit goes hard
